concept: One column of fields at the field rhythm, the buttons together at the end, and an error summary that takes focus.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a form that shows errors only as red text under each field after submit
default_to_avoid.why_not: red text under fields far down the page is easy to miss and says nothing to a screen reader; Pane adds a summary at the top

derivation.consequence: status is spoken in text as well as shown in colour
derivation.form: errors are said in words with the critical mark beside them, never only in red

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: the summary takes focus on a failed submit and each line links to its field

derivation.consequence: padding inside a pane is larger than the gap between items in it, so the edge reads as the object's boundary
derivation.form: fields sit in one column at the field rhythm with the buttons together at the end

options: A error summary at the top
C a toast that lists errors
variants.picked: A error summary at the top
variants.reason: A puts every error in one place that takes focus (P6). B is easy to miss. C disappears before it is read.

root.why: the form is one column on a reading measure

fields.why: the fields stack at the field rhythm so the eye moves down one column

actions.why: the buttons sit together after the last field

summary.why: the summary is a level-2 pane ringed in the critical mark

title.why: the summary says There is a problem in semibold beside the critical glyph

glyph.why: the critical octagon is the same glyph Banner uses

list.why: the errors are indented to line up with the title text

link.why: each error is an underlined link that moves focus to its field

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and marks so every part stays findable

focus-visible.why: the focus ring shows when the part is reached by keyboard
